description: This file contains utility functions and interfaces for expectations and matchers used in testing, including serialization, string formatting, and message construction for test assertions.

methods.name: serializeExpectedTextValues
methods.description: Serializes an array of strings or RegExp objects into ExpectedTextValue objects with optional matching options.

methods.name: formatMatcherMessage
methods.description: Constructs a detailed message string for test matcher failures, including expected, received, diff, and logs.

methods.name: callLogText
methods.description: Formats the call log array into a string for inclusion in test messages.

methods.name: printReceivedStringContainExpectedSubstring
methods.description: Formats a received string highlighting the expected substring with colors.

methods.name: printReceivedStringContainExpectedResult
methods.description: Formats the received string with the expected match result or fallback.
